title: Jude and the Wardrobe
author: Wren Oyelaran
blurb: Casper Almeida, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
